analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly RSI at 33.1 in oversold territory, weekly MACD histogram at -78.1743 continues bearish. While the daily oversold entry aligns with the weekly oversold condition, divergence exists in ADX strength and MACD histogram direction. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach based on daily indicators.
